rules.body: Apply when edits are coalesced through a reusable trailing utility while a persistent document buffer outlives its view subscription and saves can synchronously navigate. Evidence: TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Route each edit to its document's existing BufferBank trailing task. Restart that task's 120 ms quiet interval on each new edit and save only the latest pending text when the interval expires; keep the task usable for later bursts. Evidence: TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/workflow.php: "if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);" and "$this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);"

Keep pending text associated with the document identity captured by its buffer. Detaching a badge must not discard or redirect document work, and reopening a document must respect the separately owned buffer. Evidence: docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." src/workflow.php: "new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);})"

Clear the pending value and timer handle before invoking save work so synchronous callbacks can enqueue another burst without outer cleanup erasing it. Preserve the null sentinel so empty text remains a valid save. Evidence: src/workflow.php: "$value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;\n        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);"

Treat synchronous save callbacks as reentry points. If a navigation lifecycle operation invokes save work, retain the generation check after that operation so a nested open or close remains authoritative. Evidence: docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/workflow.php: "if(true&&$request!==$this->generation)return;"

Preserve synchronous store operations, public interfaces, document identities, text, and status payloads. Evidence: TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled." and "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics."

Leave search preview behavior unchanged, including its 40 ms delay, cancellation on hide, and subsequent reuse. Do not transfer the preview's discard policy to persistent document buffers. Evidence: TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.php: "new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);})" and "function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}"

Verify no write before an uninterrupted 120 ms quiet interval, one latest-text write afterward, another successful burst, and valid empty-text saves. Exercise document switching, closing, and reopening to check that pending work retains its identity and ownership. Exercise synchronous save-triggered open and close, including any departure flush the implementation chooses. Check preview delay, hide cancellation, and reuse separately. Require a source-supported boundary policy before asserting that departure must save before returning. Evidence: TASK: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

limitations: The original task and descriptive host documentation do not establish that pending edits must be flushed before departure returns. Attempt 2 implements that policy, but its passing observations do not make the policy mandatory.
The supplied sources do not fully specify edits invoked reentrantly during navigation or workspace calls after dispose.
The attempt observations support targeted verification only; they do not prove causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit across other tasks.
This guidance applies to persistent document buffers. Transient work with an explicit discard policy requires different boundary handling.
